Bicycle maintenance starts with the chain. A clean, lubricated chain shifts
smoothly and lasts longer, so wipe it with a rag, apply a drop of chain lube
to each roller, and wipe off the excess. Check tyre pressure weekly with a
gauge, because under-inflated tyres cause pinch flats. Brake pads wear down
and should be replaced when the grooves disappear. Adjust the derailleur
limit screws so the chain cannot fall off the largest or smallest cog, and
tighten the stem and seatpost bolts to the torque printed on them.
